# KONA — full machine-readable guide

An independent, unofficial fan and research project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Canyon Bicycles GmbH. Canyon and Speedmax are trademarks of their owners.

This file is generated from the same museum registries used by the public app. Stable ids in the JSON/data files are preferred over names for programmatic references.

## Evidence model
P = published source. F = visible/read from a reference photograph. I = inferred for the model. G = generated artwork. Generated or inferred material is not presented as published fact.

## Rooms and exhibits
# Rooms and what is in them

## Hawaiʻi Island / Kona guide
Race context: IRONMAN World Championship · 2026-10-10 · Kailua-Kona, Hawaiʻi
Population context: Hawaii County, Hawaii · 210,043 · estimate 2025-07-01

Visitor places:
- Kailua Pier · Kailua-Kona · race-week, history, walk · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/islands/hawaii-big-island/regions/kona/historic-kailua-village-kailua-kona
- Kailua Bay · Kailua-Kona · race-week, ocean, swim · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/islands/hawaii-big-island/things-to-do/beaches/kailua-bay
- Historic Kailua Village · Kailua-Kona · history, walk, food · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/islands/hawaii-big-island/regions/kona/historic-kailua-village-kailua-kona
- Puʻuhonua o Hōnaunau National Historical Park · South Kona · history, culture, walk · source: https://www.nps.gov/puho/planyourvisit/index.htm
- Kaloko-Honokōhau National Historical Park · North Kona · history, culture, coast, walk · source: https://www.nps.gov/kaho/learn/historyculture/index.htm
- Kealakekua Bay · South Kona · history, ocean, snorkel · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/kona
- Kona Coffee Country · North & South Kona uplands · coffee, food, culture, scenic · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/islands/hawaii-big-island/things-to-do/land-activities/coffee-plantations
- Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park · Kaʻū / Puna · volcano, landscape, hike, full-day · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/experiences/sightseeing/Volcanoes
- Puʻukoholā Heiau National Historic Site · Kawaihae · history, culture, scenic · source: https://www.nps.gov/places/puukohola-heiau.htm

Editorial stories:
- Voyaging & Kānaka Maoli: Native Hawaiians navigated to and flourished in the Hawaiian Islands for centuries, developing cultural traditions and lifeways that remain living practices today. · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/hawaiian-culture/traditions
- Royal Kona: Kailua-Kona includes places associated with Hawaiian royalty; Kamehameha I spent his later years at Kamakahonu near Kailua Pier. · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/islands/hawaii-big-island/regions/kona/historic-kailua-village-kailua-kona
- Puʻuhonua o Hōnaunau: The National Historical Park preserves major traditional Hawaiian sites, including the puʻuhonua, Royal Grounds and monumental Great Wall. · source: https://www.nps.gov/puho/learn/historyculture/index.htm
- Land shaped by volcanoes: Hawaiʻi Island includes Kīlauea, Maunaloa, Maunakea, Hualālai and Kohala; volcanic landscapes shape both the island and the race environment. · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/experiences/sightseeing/Volcanoes
- Kona coffee country: Kona coffee is grown on upland slopes in North and South Kona, where elevation, cloud cover and volcanic soils support coffee farming. · source: https://www.gohawaii.com/islands/hawaii-big-island/things-to-do/land-activities/coffee-plantations

## Privacy and app behavior
No account is required. No default analytics, ad trackers or background location tracking. Profile, Passport, finds and saved app state are local-first unless a future sync feature is explicitly enabled by the visitor.
